partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Unopposed repeated-evidence causal-module coverage
results.hypothesis: Repeated-evidence multi-target inhibition is more reliable when no counted causal target also has an opposite increased-activity assertion.
results.body: R264 excluding contradictory increased activity on every counted target
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule retains multi-target disease coverage and repeated directional evidence while removing graph-native target-direction contradictions.
results.trapi_notes: Positive and opposite-direction paths are TRAPI-expressible; absence, evidence count, rank, cardinality, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[opposite:AFFECTS]->(gene)
    WHERE opposite.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
      AND opposite.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
      AND opposite.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  }

  AND coalesce(
        effect.evidence_count,
        size(coalesce(effect.publications, [])),
        1
      ) >= 2


WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT gene) AS targeted_genes
WHERE targeted_genes >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Unopposed binding-and-direction module consensus
results.hypothesis: The strongest multi-target provenance consensus improves when no counted target also has an opposite increased-activity assertion.
results.body: R270 excluding contradictory increased activity on every counted target
results.mechanism_rationale: Independent target assignment, repeated directional evidence, and absence of an opposite effect jointly strengthen each counted intervention arm.
results.trapi_notes: Positive and opposite-direction paths are TRAPI-expressible; source aggregation, evidence count, absence, rank, cardinality, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[opposite:AFFECTS]->(gene)
    WHERE opposite.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
      AND opposite.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
      AND opposite.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  }

  AND coalesce(
        effect.evidence_count,
        size(coalesce(effect.publications, [])),
        1
      ) >= 2


UNWIND coalesce(binding.primary_knowledge_sources, []) AS binding_source
WITH subject, object, gene,
     collect(DISTINCT binding_source) AS provenance_values
WHERE size(provenance_values) >= 2

WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT gene) AS targeted_genes
WHERE targeted_genes >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
